Name: Shemidah
Summary: Son of Gilead, father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:19: Son of Gilead, father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shemidah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
